title: Microsoft Teams: Live transcription in Teams Rooms on Android
description:
View and control live transcription during a meeting from a Teams
Rooms on Android device. The real-time transcript includes speaker names and
timestamps. You can adjust settings such as spoken language, translated
language, and whether both original and translated transcripts are displayed
side by side on the front of room display. This feature is available in Teams Rooms Pro.
